desc_id: Candi Pringapus adalah candi Hindu dari abad ke-9. Di dalam ruang candinya tersimpan arca Nandi, arca lembu yang dihormati umat Hindu.
desc_en: Pringapus Temple is a Hindu temple from the 9th century. Its chamber holds a statue of Nandi, the bull honoured by Hindus.
